description: This Java class `CommandAndEventJsonExamplesProducer` generates and writes example JSON files for specific policy commands and responses used in testing or documentation within the project. It creates example JSON representations for policies like `SudoRetrievePolicy` and `SudoRetrievePolicyResponse` and saves them into designated directories.

classes.name: CommandAndEventJsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class with a main method that generates example JSON files for command and event policies used in testing or documentation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the program; validates arguments and initiates JSON file generation.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Orchestrates the production of JSON files into the specified root directory.

methods.name: produceSudoCommands
methods.description: Creates directories and writes example JSON files for sudo policy commands and responses.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes the given Jsonifiable object into a JSON string and writes it to the specified file path.
